top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete and mature arc: incretin physiology and GLP-1 secretion (Holst), identification of the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form (Mojsov) and the peptide's actions on islets, gut and appetite circuits (Drucker). It is confirmed over decades and by large independent outcome trials in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal disease. The three-name limit fits a physiology-anchored citation. The costs are Knudsen's omission and Mojsov's contested priority, but I judge them smaller than withholding an award for an achievement of this maturity and impact.
